expectBlock.comment: An expect:/always: whose value is on following lines. `while` keeps the context open for as long as the lines stay indented past the key, which is how the block's extent is known without parsing YAML.

expectInline.comment: expect: ABS(TempC - TempSP) < 0.5 — an inline scalar. A value opening with { or [ is a matcher mapping or a list, not an expression, so it is left to the YAML grammar. begin/end rather than match+captures: an `include` of another grammar only takes effect inside a real region, not inside a capture.

expressionItem.comment: A `- ` list item that is a bare scalar. Items that open a flow mapping ({ A: true }) or are a block mapping (A: true) are tag matchers, and stay YAML.

expression.comment: Structured Text, highlighted by the same grammar as a .st file — because that is exactly what the runtime compiles this string as. Quotes are stripped first so a quoted expression still highlights, and a trailing YAML comment is claimed before the ST grammar can treat it as expression text.

trailingComment.comment: In YAML a # only opens a comment when whitespace precedes it, so this cannot eat a # inside an expression.
trailingComment.name: comment.line.number-sign.yaml

quoted.comment: A YAML-quoted expression: strip the quotes off the ST so operators inside still highlight.
